title: In Vivo Smooth Muscle Cell-Specific CRISPRi Perturb-seq - PCSK9i
author: João Pinho Monteiro
materials: Chromium GEM-X Single Cell 3’ Kit v4
Reagents Tamoxifen (Sigma-Aldrich; CAS T5648-1G) Sunflower seed oil (Sigma-Aldrich; CAS S5007-259ML) 100% Ethanol Oral gavage needles (appropriate gauge/length for adult mice) + syringes

Endpoint : - Sacrifice after 9 weeks of HFD . Reagents: - Liberase TM medium Thermolysin (Roche #05401127001) - Reconstituted in HBSS to 26 units/mL. - After reconstitution, divide into single-use aliquots, as performance degrades significantly withfreeze-thaw. - Elastase (Worthington #LS002279), stock solution has variable concentration - HBSS, calcium, magnesium, no phenol red (Gibco # 14025092) - PBS Equipment: - Fine dissection scissors (e.g. FST 14058-09) - 5mL Round Bottom Polystyrene FACS Tubes w/ 35um Strainer Cap (Falcon # 352235). - Pre-cooled centrifuge at 4°C w/ swing bucket

steps.title: Prepare 20 mg/mL tamoxifen solution
steps.instruction: Mix 9 parts sunflower oil with 1 part ethanol (e.g., 900 µL oil + 100 µL ethanol) to make the vehicle, add 20 mg tamoxifen to 1 mL of this vehicle, dissolve overnight at 37 °C, then store at 4 °C for up to 1 week.

steps.title: Administer tamoxifen by oral gavage
steps.instruction: At 7–8 weeks of age give two oral gavage doses of the 20 mg/mL tamoxifen solution, each at ~0.2 mg per gram body weight, spaced 72–96 h apart (e.g., a 30 g mouse receives 6 mg → 0.3 mL).

steps.title: Prepare mPcsk9 AAV dilution
steps.instruction: Thaw the AAV on ice; if not using the whole vial, aliquot the remainder, refreeze on dry ice and store at –80 °C. Dilute in sterile DPBS to a final concentration of 1 × 10¹² vg/mL in a total volume of 100 µL per mouse, load into a 31G insulin syringe and minimize bubbles.

steps.title: First retro‑orbital AAV injection
steps.instruction: One week after the first tamoxifen dose, inject 100 µL of the 1 × 10¹² vg/mL mPcsk9 AAV retro‑orbitally.

substeps.instruction: Place mouse in an induction chamber and start isoflurane at 3–4 % with a flow of 0.8–1.0 L/min.
When breathing slows to ~1 breath/s, maintain anesthesia at 1–2 % isoflurane via nose cone.
Position mouse on its side, press both upper and lower eyelids to slightly protrude the globe.
Apply one drop of 0.5 % proparacaine HCl to the eye to be injected; dab excess with sterile gauze after a few seconds.
Using a 1 mL syringe (or smaller) with a 27–30 G, ½" needle, insert at a 30–45° angle, bevel down, lateral to the medial canthus, through the conjunctival membrane.
Advance the needle until the bony orbit is reached but not penetrated, retract slightly, then inject 100 µL slowly.
Remove the needle slowly, close the eyelids, and apply mild pressure with a gauze sponge.
Transfer mouse to a paper‑lined cage on a heating pad, monitor every 15 min until ambulatory.

steps.title: Start Western high‑fat diet
steps.instruction: Begin the Western high‑fat diet at the time of the first mPcsk9 AAV injection and maintain the diet for 9 weeks.

steps.title: Second retro‑orbital AAV‑PR injection
steps.instruction: Four weeks after the first mPcsk9 AAV injection (and diet initiation), perform a retro‑orbital injection of AAV‑PR using the same procedure as the first injection (100 µL of 1 × 10¹² vg/mL).

steps.title: Prepare enzyme solution for aortic digestion
steps.instruction: On ice, make a 1 mL enzyme mix containing 2 U/mL Liberase (final 2 U/mL) and 2 U/mL Elastase (final 2 U/mL): 77 µL Liberase TM (26 U/mL), 16 µL Elastase (125 U/mL), and 907 µL HBSS. Keep on ice.

steps.title: Perfuse mouse and harvest aortic root
steps.instruction: Anesthetize mouse with isoflurane (3–4 %, 0.8–1.0 L/min) to surgical depth, perform midline skin incision, open abdomen and thorax, puncture diaphragm, thoracotomy, incise right atrium for exsanguination, insert a 25–27 G needle into left ventricle or ascending aorta and perfuse ~10 mL sterile PBS until tissues blanch and effluent runs clear, then harvest the aortic root and open it longitudinally.

steps.title: Digest aortic tissue to single cells
steps.instruction: Wash the aortic root three times with PBS in a 12‑well dish on ice, transfer to a well containing 1 mL enzyme mixture, incubate at 37 °C for 30–45 min (adjust up to 45 min for heavily calcified tissue), mince on ice for ≤5 min until mostly dissolved, pipet up/down 20–30 times, verify single‑cell suspension under a microscope; if incomplete, incubate an additional 10–15 min (no longer).

substeps.instruction: Transfer the suspension to a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube and centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min.
Carefully remove supernatant, resuspend pellet in 300 µL HBSS (adjust volume if needed).
Immediately before FACS, pass the cell suspension through a 35 µm strainer (coating collection tubes with 10 % BSA may improve survival).

steps.title: Sort tdT⁺/GFP⁺ cells by FACS
steps.instruction: Using flow cytometry, isolate the dual‑positive tdT⁺ (lineage‑traced SMC‑derived) and GFP⁺ (AAV‑transduced) cell population.

steps.title: Generate 10x single‑cell libraries
steps.instruction: Follow the 10x Genomics Chromium GEM‑X Single Cell 3’ v4 standard protocol (User Guide CG000731) and the Feature Barcoding guide (CG000389), specifically Step 2.3C followed by Step 4 for guide‑library construction, to prepare libraries from the sorted cells.

description: Abstract (JPM Edited 2/25/26) This protocol describes an in vivo smooth muscle cell (SMC)-specific Perturb-seq workflow enabling targeted gene repression and single-cell transcriptional profiling during atherosclerosis. Using Myh11 CreERT2 ; ROSA tdT/+ ; dCas9 KRAB mice, dCas9-KRAB expression is induced in adult SMCs via tamoxifen administration. One week after tamoxifen induction, mice receive a single systemic AAV injection via retro-orbital delivery under isoflurane anesthesia to introduce sgRNAs targeting genes of interest or non-targeting controls. At defined endpoints, aortic roots are harvested and enzymatically dissociated to generate single-cell suspensions. Dual-positive tdTomato⁺/GFP-reporter⁺ cells are isolated by FACS and processed using the 10x Genomics Chromium platform for single-cell RNA sequencing and CRISPR guide capture. This integrated workflow enables high-resolution, lineage-traced functional genomics in vivo , allowing assessment of SMC state transitions and gene regulatory perturbations. Conditional smooth muscle cell dCas9-KRAB knock-in allele with lineage tracing [JPM2] We have obtained several lines of genetically modified mice from other laboratories, and combined alleles to undertake experiments outlined in here. To lineage trace vascular smooth muscle cells (SMC), we employed a SMC-specific mouse Cre allele ( Myh11 CreERT2 ; Tg Myh11-CreERT2 ; 019079; JAX) combined with a Cre-responsive reporter gene (tandem dimer Tomato, tdT ) inserted at the ROSA26 locus ( ROSA tdT/+ ; B6.Cg-Gt(ROSA)26Sor tm14(CAGtdTomato)Hze /J ; 007914; JAX) Adding a conditional dCas9-KRAB knock-in ( dCas9 KRAB ; B6.129S6- Gt(ROSA)26Sor tm2(CAG-cas9*/ZNF10*)Gers /J; 033066; JAX) mutation with these alleles has created the experimental mice, Myh11 CreERT2 , dCas9 KRAB , ROSA tdT/+ , that are both lineage traced for the SMC lineage and have SMC specific expression of dCas9-KRAB . All mice are on C57Bl/6 background. Detailed Description of dCas9-KRAB knock-in allele -
